f70bc0f9b7bee12a503fa27a6cacea62.overview: During a bitter 1964 Massachusetts winter, young secretary Eileen becomes enchanted by Rebecca, the glamorous new counselor at the prison where she works. Their budding friendship takes a twisted turn when Rebecca reveals a dark secret — throwing Eileen onto a sinister path.
f70bc0f9b7bee12a503fa27a6cacea62.tagline: Crime has never felt so intoxicating.

f70f35ea3e43a21413b55c1af53e67c2.overview: After a former model is drowned in her bathtub, Detective James Halloran and Lieutenant Dan Muldoon attempt to piece together her murder.
f70f35ea3e43a21413b55c1af53e67c2.tagline: The soul of a city. Her glory stripped! Her passion bared!

f71b4a3355fe86239ab0f7de15ad76f9.overview: Sally and Gillian Owens, born into a magical family, have mostly avoided witchcraft themselves. But when Gillian's vicious boyfriend, Jimmy Angelov, dies unexpectedly, the Owens sisters give themselves a crash course in hard magic. With policeman Gary Hallet growing suspicious, the girls struggle to resurrect Angelov -- and unwittingly inject his corpse with an evil spirit that threatens to end their family line.
f71b4a3355fe86239ab0f7de15ad76f9.tagline: For two sisters from a family of witches, falling in love is the trickiest spell of all.

f721bc3bef8ff217b0f1f8248ba2e1d2.overview: Growing up in post-World War II era Arizona, young Sammy Fabelman aspires to become a filmmaker as he reaches adolescence, but soon discovers a shattering family secret and explores how the power of films can help him see the truth.

f74e6018ed271551fb189062edcdbfaa.overview: A retired San Francisco detective suffering from acrophobia investigates the strange activities of an old friend's wife, all the while becoming dangerously obsessed with her.
f74e6018ed271551fb189062edcdbfaa.tagline: Alfred Hitchcock engulfs you in a whirlpool of terror and tension!

f75671a08c5110e9b2be68cdab67f422.overview: New York layabout Willie forms an unexpected bond with his young Hungarian cousin Eva when she pays him a surprise visit. Later, Eva moves in with their aunt in Cleveland, and Willie takes his best friend Eddie to see her—a visit that culminates in a strange, eventful trip to Florida.

f79c152c7ddde14eeede383968f0979f.overview: As the host of a literary TV show, Georges begins receiving anonymously filmed videos of his family alongside cryptic, disturbing drawings, but as the tapes become increasingly intimate, they reveal a stalker who has known him for a very long time.

f7a7f91d954e5fd75d6acd641e965baf.overview: Three kindly old men decide to light up the dimming twilight of their lives with a last blaze of glory – by sticking up a Manhattan bank in broad daylight.
f7a7f91d954e5fd75d6acd641e965baf.tagline: Whether they win or lose, they'll be "Going in Style"

f7a827894e4a06657f12c4393bfb0afa.overview: Executive George Dupler loses his temper and is demoted to the night manager at a 24 hour drugstore. After he suggests to his teenage son Freddie that he stop having an affair with suburban housewife Cheryl Gibbons, who is a distant cousin, Cheryl tries to seduce George. At home, in front of his mother, Freddie accuses his dad of stealing his girl, because he found Cheryl serving George a meal in the middle of the night, while her husband Bobby was on duty at the fire station. George then separates from his wife Helen, quits his job, moves into a warehouse, and asks Cheryl to move in with him.
f7a827894e4a06657f12c4393bfb0afa.tagline: She's got a way with men. And she's getting away with it...

f7ac6b12fd97692f9c9a5121115bdf3d.overview: Glendon Wasey is a fortune hunter looking for a fast track out of China. Gloria Tatlock is a missionary nurse seeking the curing powers of opium for her patients. Fate sets them on a hectic, exotic, and even romantic quest for stolen drugs. But they are up against every thug and smuggler in Shangai.
f7ac6b12fd97692f9c9a5121115bdf3d.tagline: A romantic adventure for the dangerous at heart.

f7cec19e9700c0e666ca54ad4fa39c50.overview: On the way to pick up the bounty on a wanted murderer, a bounty hunter stops at a staging post where he is forced to continue his journey with two outlaws who want the murderer for their own reasons and a recently-widowed woman, with the murderer's brother and his men in hot pursuit.
f7cec19e9700c0e666ca54ad4fa39c50.tagline: Scorching lead-hot action all the way!

f7f68f891d1864b80d468e1e04aca0d1.overview: Hans is a street fruit peddler and born loser. His choice of career upsets his bourgeois family, causing him to turn to drinking and violence. After recovering from a debilitating heart attack, his business finally begins to take off. However, the more he becomes a credit to his family, the more depressed he becomes.

f7ffbe8505d8a98d9d6e38f4242d97fb.overview: Meet Joel Goodson, an industrious, college-bound 17-year-old and a responsible, trustworthy son. However, when his parents go away and leave him home alone in the wealthy Chicago suburbs with the Porsche at his disposal he quickly decides he has been good for too long and it is time to enjoy himself. After an unfortunate incident with the Porsche Joel must raise some cash, in a risky way.
f7ffbe8505d8a98d9d6e38f4242d97fb.tagline: There's a time for playing it safe and a time for Risky Business.
